extracted.name: Original cheesecake
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member emilymango and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: handful strawberries or raspberries or any marmalade of your choice to serve (optional)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 180C/ fan 160C/ gas 4.
Blend the digestive biscuits and the butter in a food processor until the mixture looks like wet sand. Then, press the mixture into the bottom of the tin (20cm) and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Cool the base of the cheesecake while preparing the filling.
Stir in a bowl the soft cheese and the caster sugar for a little. Continue by adding the double cream. Pour the mixture in the tin and smooth with a spoon or a spatula.
Leave to set in the fridge for 1 hour or better overnight and serve with strawberries or raspberries or any marmalade you like.
